title: Yoshimoto Mahjong Club
overview:
Your opponents: 26 mahjong-savvy celebrities hand-picked from Yoshimoto! These guys are pretty tough...!

This is what happens when you sit down at the table with comedians...! A mahjong game that faithfully recreates the vibe of "Yoshimoto Mahjong Club", currently airing as a late-night program. For its development, the 26 comedians taking part were thoroughly analyzed. Their gags and quirks, their playing style and mahjong skill, are exactly like the real thing.

相手は、吉本から選りすぐった、雀通・タレント26人！コイツらは、かなり手強いぞ…！

芸人たちと卓を囲むと、こうなる…！深夜番組として放映中の「よしもと麻雀倶楽部」のノリをそのまま再現した、麻雀ゲーム。開発に当たっては、参戦する26人の芸人を徹底的に分析。ギャグもクセも、打ちスジも雀力も、まさに本人そのものだ。
